scope: Static review of the independent-state and raw-byte comparison boundary for an additive diagnostic source candidate. This document does not record an executed oracle, qualify a runtime, select a candidate, change a baseline or establish performance acceptance.
original_stock_comparison: The existing failed stock raw-input comparison remains failed. This diagnostic cannot replace that result or select a baseline.

initial_state.capture_point: Before take_bucket restores any prepared effects, within the same compiler callback and bucket, after the exact original typed pruned Krate and Ctx::new inputs exist.
shared_immutable_inputs: Exact pruned Krate and its ordered vectors
Exact verification options and selected bucket
initial_state.construction: Construct independent Ctx::new owners from the same inputs, with explicitly forked GlobalCtx mutable owners. Validate equal initial state before either arm runs. Never start fresh lowering from an already restored Ctx.

mutable_boundaries.risk: Clone shares Rc<RefCell<NameCtxtImpl>>; the first arm could change the second arm's names.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Allocate a new name owner and restore an independent copy of exact initial name contents.

mutable_boundaries.risk: from_self_with_log clears their contents instead of preserving the exact initial state.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Copy exact initial contents into independent RefCells; do not share cells or silently reset baseline contents.

mutable_boundaries.risk: Capture clone shares Arc<Mutex<State>> and can contaminate graph recording.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Use an independent capture owner; do not modify the primary ledger, preparation counters or cache.

mutable_boundaries.owner: Interpreter and function-call graph log owners
mutable_boundaries.risk: GlobalCtx clones share mutable Arc<Mutex<Option<File>>> owners.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Reject unsupported active logging or allocate independently owned private logs. No shadow writes to primary log files.

mutable_boundaries.owner: Verifier counters, bucket statistics and log paths
mutable_boundaries.risk: Verifier::from_self clears statistics but shares created_log_dir and created_solver_log_dir Arcs.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Initialize independent bucket statistics, replace both log-directory owners with private arm paths, preserve exact options, and never merge a shadow Verifier into the primary.

mutable_boundaries.risk: Suppressing emit alone does not suppress progress_start's mutation of the global ORDINALS map.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Return before all shadow event-related state mutations, including progress_start. Do not clear, initialize, finish or access the primary prepared cache from a shadow arm.

mutable_boundaries.risk: Using the primary Reporter or QueuedReporter emits ordinary diagnostics and changes visible ordering.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Collect independently with exact emission class, level, message and grouped report_as_multi boundaries. Compare preparation and verification diagnostics without forwarding shadow messages.

mutable_boundaries.risk: Reusing an AIR context, solver process or cached reply makes the two arms depend on each other.
mutable_boundaries.requirement: Create fresh independent AIR contexts and direct pinned solver processes with identical options. Avoid process-global environment changes while bucket workers run.

comparison.ordered_solver_requests: Compare the ordered sequence of exact actual request bytes for each arm's solver-launch ordinal. Do not sort sessions, commands or declarations, and do not normalize bytes.
comparison.framing: SmtProcess::writer_thread writes each request, one LF, then the exact echo marker command and LF. A transcript log with QUERY delimiters is not the raw request stream.
comparison.capture_ownership: Pass the arm-local capture owner into each spawned writer explicitly; thread-local state does not propagate to spawned threads.
comparison.completion: Require complete captures, all actual writes accounted for, solver termination, complete diagnostics and final bucket outcomes. Missing, failed, overbudget or truncated captures are unavailable or failed, never equal.
comparison.independent_evidence: Ordered SST and exact effects comparisons may localize a failure, but cannot substitute for the raw solver-byte and outcome comparison.

required_adversarial_cases: Mutating one arm's naming, qid, quantifier or chosen-trigger state does not change another arm or the primary.
Changing a prepared function body is detected even when preparation metadata still appears valid.
Changing restored naming or quantifier effects is detected by actual emitted solver bytes.
Reordering prepared functions or fuel declarations is detected; solver inputs are not sorted to hide it.
Duplicating, dropping or reordering a solver session is detected by ordered session capture.
Changing diagnostic emission class, level or message grouping is detected.
Truncated capture, solver failure or unavailable initial-state equality never produces an oracle pass.
Running the diagnostic does not alter primary obligation identifiers, preparation counters, ordinary diagnostics or report seals.
performance_scope: Two shadow proofs and their independent working state are diagnostic overhead. Retained preparation budgets remain unchanged; shadow wall time and RSS must be recorded separately and cannot establish the M7 performance goal.
